name: ABB Infinitus 800 VDC distribution and protection (announced)
model: Infinitus DC power distribution / DC protection
description: DC power distribution and DC protection blocks of ABB's Infinitus source-to-rack 800 VDC portfolio (launched Sept 2026). No ratings published; ABB says major components enter production within 12 months. Ratings estimated from ABB's shipping DC breakers.

capacity_w.note: no Infinitus switchgear rating published. Estimated as 2500-5000 A main bus x 800 V = 2.0-4.0 MW; 5000 A is the top SACE Emax DC frame (up to 1000 V DC), 2500 A the SACE Infinitus solid-state breaker frame (press reports). Matches one 2-3 MW SST per lineup

rating_a.note: assumed main bus 2500-5000 A, based on ABB DC breaker frames

voltage_v.note: press report: Infinitus portfolio is built around 800 VDC

attrs.status: announced 2026-09; production expected within 12 months (press report)

sources.title: ABB launches source-to-rack 800 VDC architecture (Converge Digest, 2026-09-22)
